name: chain_verify
reasoning: All logical chains are internally consistent. The statements form a coherent diagnostic chain: recurrent fever, RUQ pain, hepatic mass-like lesions, granulomatous hepatitis with fibrin-ring granulomas, and a largely negative infectious workup all support Q fever hepatitis due to Coxiella burnetii. The intermediate differential statements are consistent with and appropriately narrowed by the biopsy and negative testing, so no broken logical dependencies are present.
